purpose: Teach: 辞める/肩書き/党内/プロダクト/親会社/やりがい/チャネル/紛失

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、辞める、絶対、警官、絶対、減らす策、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're seriously considering measures to reduce police staffing levels. We appreciate your understanding.
lines.style: Even, measured tone. Professional distance maintained throughout. Steady eye contact. Speaks with quiet authority, not defensiveness. No rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の、本気で、絶対、肩書き、絶対、整理、絶対、進められて、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the progress being made on organizational restructuring within the department.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Warm but not familiar. Slightly softer attack than the officer — deferential without being obsequious. Genuine gratitude underneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、党内、絶対、人事、絶対、関与しない、絶対、立場です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I want to be clear: the police department maintains its own position independent of internal political pressures.
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. Light emphasis on 「独立」 implied in the delivery. Clinical precision. Not angry, but definitely drawing a boundary.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の、本気で、絶対、プロダクト、絶対、デモ、絶対、見せていただきありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're truly grateful to have been shown the product demonstration and operational capabilities.
lines.style: Genuine interest breaking through formality. Slightly faster pace here — less guarded. Still respectful, but this is where Kenji's warmth shows through the protocol.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、親会社、絶対、なような、絶対、公安、絶対、連携、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police maintain active coordination with public security partners, similar to how we work with parent organizations.
lines.style: Calm assertion. No defensiveness. Speaking from established fact. Slight pause before 「公安」 — choosing words carefully but not hesitantly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、やりがい、絶対、ある、絶対、お仕事、絶対、尊敬しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I deeply respect the meaningful work your officers do every day.
lines.style: Sincere pivot. Softer onset. This is not performative — it's what Kenji actually means. Slight lift at the end, like he wanted to say it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、情報の、絶対、チャネル、絶対、整備、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We'll ensure information channels are properly established and maintained.
lines.style: Businesslike but not cold. Concrete commitment. Steady rhythm. Light emphasis on 「整備」 — this is a promise being made.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証拠の、本気で、絶対、紛失、絶対、警察、絶対、防止、絶対、徹底ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're committed to thorough protocols preventing evidence loss. It's a priority.
lines.style: Slight intensification. More direct. Kenji's voice gets quieter here, more serious. Not accusatory — just: this matters, and we know it.
